verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API with a versioned `/api/v1/*` path, a changelog, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages). Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference, a try-it console, or runnable examples. Static reference docs are adjacent to this story and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
